title: DSSI marketing website (Astro)
body: Marketing site for DSSI lives in company-workspace/marketing-website. Built in an earlier session; rebranded to DSSI; content rewritten for all-industry positioning. GitHub: https://github.com/maaarcsilva3/dssi-marketing-website. Local preview: cd company-workspace/marketing-website && npm install && npx astro dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321. Launch caveat: placeholder email hello@dssi.example until real contact/Cal.com is set.
